name: CB Heatmap
summary: Privacy-first player activity heatmap for FiveM.
description: CB Heatmap is a privacy-focused FiveM activity heatmap that uses OneSync player activity to generate an anonymous, organic heatmap over a GTA V map. Player coordinates are quantized and jittered before being used, and no exact player locations are persisted. The generated heatmap can be published to Discord through a single persistent message that is updated automatically.
